title: Paleo Chicken Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy paleo recipe for chicken stir fry. Simply sauté the ingredients in a pan and serve.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the mushrooms, onions, and bell peppers to the skillet.
Cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the paleo stir fry sauce to the skillet and stir to combine.
Return the chicken to the skillet and stir to coat with the sauce.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
